newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate eases as speculation fades.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate eases as speculation fades.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were down 185 basis points at 18.15 percent in mid-morning trade on Wednesday.
Dealers said speculation had subsided after jacking up overnight rates to 20.00 percent at the close on Tuesday, which they said was far above average trading rates for that session.
"Tuesday's closing rates were unreal, someone who had money forced rates up. What is happening now is the market is returning to average trading levels," a dealer said.
Overnight rates on bank paper had meanwhile retreated 90 basis points to trade at 19.60 percent.
Liquidity of 2.036 billion pesos was due to return to the system from prior central bank operations.
